title: Titanic survivor's account of angels in a craft by the lifeboats

tellings.quote: Titanic, it described a group of angels who came in a craft land one of the lifeboats and landed on the ledge of one of the icebergs

plain: When the Titanic sank in the North Atlantic in 1912, a survivor in one of the lifeboats is said to have seen a group of angels arrive in a craft, land by a lifeboat and set down on the ledge of an iceberg. Charles Hall, a man who says he spent years among tall white aliens at a military base, tells Michels he read this in a book on the Titanic that he does not name, as the account of a survivor later picked up by the rescue ship Carpathia. To Hall it suggests that beings like the ones he describes were present at the disaster.
